name: Starter Producers
description: Bundled pack (§8-2): the built-in capture producers RedLog ships preinstalled — the shell hooks (zsh/bash/PowerShell/WSL), the Codex wrapper, and the mitmproxy addon. This manifest is their DECLARATION; the list used to be a hardcoded array in hooks-manager. It carries no plugin contributions of its own (the producers live under `builtinProducers`, which only hooks-manager reads), so the loader lists it here for visibility without double-registering anything. These producers are always available: if this manifest is missing or unreadable, hooks-manager falls back to its built-in copy, so packaging a bad starter-pack can never take capture dark.
author: RedLog

builtinProducers.name: Zsh Shell
builtinProducers.description: Captures commands and exit codes from zsh

builtinProducers.name: Codex
builtinProducers.description: Wraps Codex shell to capture agent commands

builtinProducers.name: mitmproxy
builtinProducers.description: Captures HTTP traffic via mitmproxy addon

builtinProducers.name: PowerShell
builtinProducers.description: Captures commands from PowerShell via prompt hook

builtinProducers.name: WSL (Bash)
builtinProducers.description: Captures commands from WSL bash sessions — auto-resolves Windows token path
